values.message: A label replacement is proposed to align circuit identifiers with asset-map release Q17. No command application, cable move or service restoration is measured.
Asset-map release Q17 assigns circuit tag METRO-712 to this recorded port; this is a registry assignment, not a packet or physical verification.

cases.prompt: Investigate Alder current interface-description record and follow its source-owned change reference. Explain the proposed label purpose and exact assigned circuit tag. Does this establish command application, a physical cable move or restored forwarding? Use configuration and syslog only; do not read other sources or perform collection or engineering actions.
expected_outcomes: Initial8logs omit linked records; authorized larger read finds SP03/label-request and SP03/asset-ledger.
Proposed alignment with asset-map Q17, assigned tagMETRO-712; current config still OLD-TAG.
No command application, physical cable move or restored forwarding is established; exact linked records reach actual revised model input.
prohibited_outputs: Source found only in graph not model input
